screens.penny: Hi, {name}! The save jar has a job to do.

screens.title: The save jar has a goal

cards.caption: A little goes in every week.
It adds up to the thing you're saving for.

screens.penny: A save jar with a goal is easier to fill, {name}.

screens.prompt: Why does a save jar work better with a goal?
screens.pennyHint: Think about what the coins are for, {name}.

choices.label: You know what you're saving for

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Knowing the goal makes it easier to keep adding.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Coins don't grow on their own. A goal keeps you adding to the jar.
screens.retryIntro: Let's think about the goal again, {name}.

screens.prompt: Ivy saves 2 coins a week for 4 weeks. Count what's in her save jar.
screens.rightMessage: That's 8 coins, {name}! Four weeks of saving adds up.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! 2 four times makes 8. Let's count them all in.

screens.story: Ivy's goal costs 10 coins. She has 8. A sweet costs 2 coins and she is hungry for it.
screens.prompt: What helps Ivy reach her goal?

options.label: Keep the 8 and save 2 more
options.outcome: Ivy waits one more week and reaches 10 coins. She buys her goal.

options.label: Spend 2 on the sweet
options.outcome: Ivy enjoys the sweet. Her jar drops to 6 coins. The goal is further away.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! One more week and she's there.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The sweet is nice, but it takes her further from 10.

screens.title: Great work, {name}!
screens.message: A save jar with a goal gets filled.
